about: Approve on screen 2 fires it. Saves the finished email as a file and gets it signed off.
name: Approval routing

nodes.action: When Power Apps calls a flow
nodes.expect: Approve on screen 2 calls it with the month and the finished email's HTML (composed once, htmlForSend).
nodes.title: Approve pressed

nodes.expect: Saves YYYY-MM.html. A column can't hold it: September's email is 62,216 characters against a 63,999 limit.
nodes.title: Create file: Issue Files

nodes.action: Start and wait for an approval
nodes.expect: Reviewers get the file link. The approval rule is yours (default: you alone, first to respond).
nodes.title: Start and wait for an approval

nodes.expect: Yes or No from the approval.
nodes.title: Approved?

nodes.expect: Status Approved. Draft and send starts from this.
nodes.title: Update item: Issues -> Approved

nodes.expect: Status back to Editing so you can change it and approve again.
nodes.title: Update item: Issues -> Editing

nodes.action: Post message in a chat or channel
nodes.expect: The reviewers' comments, so you see why it came back.
nodes.title: Post the comments to Teams
